description: This file defines an enumeration for various order statuses used in the order lifecycle, including a method to parse status from API responses, with support for unknown values.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Enum class representing different statuses in the order lifecycle, including a static method to convert string inputs to enum values.

methods.name: fromApi
methods.description: Converts a string API value into the corresponding OrderStatus enum, returning UNKNOWN for null, empty, or unrecognized strings.
